get.description: Category is required unless q is present. q is trimmed, 1–100 Unicode code points/400 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters or unpaired surrogates. Literal ASCII case-insensitive name-only substring matching uses explicit ASCII folding and C collation. Chinese and other non-ASCII code points remain literal; no accent, pinyin or Unicode normalization. %, _ and backslash are literal. Accepted snapshot ordering; no totals, contacts, private actors or raw media.
